description: See what every agent thread costs in dollars while it runs, per prompt and across all your threads. A chip beside the context circle shows the thread's total and what the last prompt added; click it for where the money went, a chart of every model call and the total with child threads. The Burn tab in the side panel lists the cost of each prompt, and a Burn page in bb's navigation charts spend across threads by day, project, model and harness. Budgets notify you at 80% and 100% of a thread's budget, and stop a run only if you turn that on. Works with pi, Codex, Claude Code and any harness that reports usage to bb; where a harness records no cost, Burn estimates it from list prices and marks it with ~.
